map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. One red colleague learns from every crash; out-learn it for Certification.

tiles.title: The welcome wall
tiles.newIdea: Controls: walk into the red colleague's path; it never brakes.
tiles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor. Your colleague has learned nothing yet. Neither have you. Make engineering proud.
tiles.hint: Walk into its lane. It will not stop.

tiles.title: The podium bridge
tiles.newIdea: After one crash it brakes for dummies in its lane.
tiles.tale: Battery 1 arrives when your colleague first brakes. It now stops for anyone in its lane. Arrive from the side.
tiles.hint: Once it brakes for you, dash in from beside the lane.

tiles.title: The LED drum
tiles.newIdea: Side sensors: it stops for a dummy waiting beside the road.
tiles.tale: Side sensors fitted, per policy. Lingering at the kerb is now noticed. Legs 1 arrives; go over, not beside.
tiles.hint: Wait on the plinth, or jump in over the kerb.

tiles.title: The portal tower
tiles.newIdea: Roof lidar: it sees a dummy raised on the plinth.
tiles.tale: Head office approved roof lidar. The plinth no longer hides you. Height was a privilege; jumping is a right.
tiles.hint: Leave the plinth. Jump in from the gap or cover.

tiles.title: The monument
tiles.newIdea: Street cameras: it sees a dummy hiding behind cover.
tiles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS. Street cameras now watch behind cover. Hands 1 arrives: a cone makes colleagues stop.
tiles.hint: Drop a cone in its lane, then dash as it swerves.

tiles.title: The neon shops
tiles.newIdea: DUCK: crouch behind low planters; it now stops for cones.
tiles.tale: The neon shops sell nothing. Your colleague stops for cones. DUCK arrives: the planters are low, and so are you.
tiles.hint: Duck behind a planter. Spring as it passes.

tiles.title: The stacked cubes
tiles.newIdea: Crash memory: it watches every spot where it hit you.
tiles.tale: The cubes rose one budget at a time. Your colleague keeps records now. Never be filed in the same place.
tiles.hint: Each hit from a new spot. It remembers the old ones.

tiles.title: The LED canyon
tiles.newIdea: The search: lose it after being seen, and it hunts your ghost.
tiles.tale: Two screens advertise to each other all night. Seen, then hidden, you are searched for. Crawl further than its curiosity.
tiles.hint: Once seen, crawl far from your ghost, or use the lure.

tiles.title: The LED gateway
tiles.newIdea: Two-way roads: white colleagues that never learn give moving cover.
tiles.tale: The gateway thanks every car for driving safely. White colleagues never learn. Hide behind them; strike unseen for Certification.
tiles.hint: Walk beside a white car, then dash at red unseen.

rationale: One rung per tile, 10.1 to 10.9, never backwards. I dropped 10.10 because skipping any earlier stage gives the car a rung the player never sees it learn. Counts follow the measured open ways: 2 on teach tiles, 3 where many ways stay open (10.3, 10.4, 10.7), and back to 2 on the narrow 10.5 and 10.6. The overrides make the first side field and the first duck easier, and bring the car back sooner on 10.5. The payoff on 10.9 reopens many ways and asks for unseen strikes.
